projects.title: GMG SaaS Platform Modernization
projects.description: Spearheaded migration from .NET Framework to .NET 8, including SQL CE to SQLite data migration and architectural cleanup for long-term platform stability. Kept a mission-critical commercial SaaS product running throughout the transition.

projects.title: Printer Hardware IPC Integration
projects.description: Built the complete IPC layer between SaaS software and professional printer hardware using Named Pipes and socket networking — enabling reliable real-time communication and eliminating race conditions in hardware-software interaction.

projects.title: Multi-Tenant Authorization Platform
projects.description: Architected RESTful APIs with OAuth2 and JWT authentication and fine-grained authorization using Authzed (Google Zanzibar-inspired) — supporting complex cross-tenant permission models for a commercial SaaS platform.

projects.title: MCP Server with RAG-Indexed Codebase
projects.description: Built an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server with RAG-indexed codebase routes for AI-assisted development, making it easier for the team to navigate complex legacy code and accelerating onboarding.

projects.title: Enterprise Analytics & Regulatory Reporting Platform
projects.description: Sole architect and technical lead of a regulatory-grade BI platform (React.js, Node.js, microservices) aggregating real-time transaction data from 400+ branches, ATM, POS, and core banking — used by senior management and submitted to Central Bank regulators.

projects.title: Shetab National Card Network Integration
projects.description: Spearheaded R&D and architecture for Iran's Shetab national card network integration at Postbank of Iran — Java-based high-availability services for real-time national payment transaction processing.

projects.title: Chakavak National Cheque-Clearing Backbone
projects.description: Owned IBM MQ architecture for the Chakavak national cheque-clearing system — fault-tolerant asynchronous processing across distributed nodes under strict Central Bank regulatory SLAs.

projects.title: Core Banking Platform — 15,000 Concurrent Users
projects.description: Architected and delivered a full-scope core banking platform (.NET, C#) spanning Accounting, Treasury, HR, Branch Operations, and Supervisor workflows — 15-node distributed SQL Server cluster, 15,000 concurrent users, ACID-compliant transactional isolation.

projects.title: Amitis Hamta FinTech Platform
projects.description: Software architecture consultant for Amitis Hamta Co. — strategic guidance on full-stack architecture and secure payment panel integration for a fintech platform (2019–2022).

projects.title: POS Terminal & ATM Integration Software
projects.description: Developed C++ POS terminal software with hardware-level protocol integration and ATM/card processing modules with real-time authorisation and settlement flows.
